tools.name: image_info
tools.description: Inspect image metadata — format, dimensions, color mode, and file size. Accepts a base64-encoded image string or a URL. Only reads headers, not full image data. Use for questions like 'what size is this image' or 'what format is this image file'.

input.description: Either a base64-encoded image (with or without data URI prefix) or an http/https URL to an image
